prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: About 4 years as Systems Architect across Linkme and TYcodes fits the 3-5 year requirement.
Project management certification is adjacent; no evidence of writing BRDs, SCDs, or Epic briefs.
Data validation pipelines are related, but no evidence of validating delivery cost estimates or COGS.
No evidence of Agile, Scrum, waterfall, or iterative delivery methodology.
Built an AI demo generator, but no evidence of RFP, RFI, or proposal materials.
Cross-functional ops CRM and data pipelines are adjacent; no explicit dependency coordination shown.
Error-reduction validation work is related to risk, but no scope drift or corrective action plans shown.
No evidence of loyalty marketing programs or mechanics.
No evidence of delivery work in retail, financial services, or travel and hospitality.
Built an operations CRM module, but no campaign, CDP, or personalization platform use shown.
No evidence addressing willingness or ability to travel quarterly.
Based in Weston, FL, not St. Petersburg; remote or hybrid fit depends on commute arrangement.

output.verdict_line: The candidate fits the experience level and architecture background but shows gaps in BRD writing, Agile methodology, and loyalty marketing.
top_gaps: Documents business requirements into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs
Applies Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodologies
Validates delivery cost estimates (COGS) across workstreams
